validation.password-too-short: Password must be at least 6 characters

delete-confirm.title: Delete Database
delete-confirm.body: This will permanently delete database "{name}" and all its data. This action cannot be undone.
delete-confirm.name-label: Type the database name to confirm

backup.title: Backup Data Directory
backup.ratio-hint: Parity shards = data shards × this ratio. Higher ratio tolerates more corruption at the cost of a larger backup file.
backup.volume-structure: The backup file consists of Reed-Solomon data and parity shards; its size is about (1 + redundancy ratio) times the source data.

restore.title: Restore Data Directory
restore.warning-text: Restoring will overwrite all user data and cannot be undone.
restore.verify-result-recoverable: Backup file passed verification, ready to restore
restore.verify-result-recoverable-with-loss: Backup file has {lost} corrupted block(s), still recoverable
restore.verify-result-irrecoverable: Backup file is too damaged to restore

restore-success.title: Restore Successful
restore-success.text: Click the button below to refresh the page and view your restored data.
